To her, having a name means being tamed by humans.

All she wants is to be the fastest, freest cat in the world. 
But the fat cook has the most skillful hands in the world, he makes the most delicious fish stew. 
He also has the cleanest eyes in the world. Eyes that see her, but never try to tame her. 
So Windrider stayed. 
Just for now, she thought.
